elements.label: Outer border left ornate set
elements.notes: Candidate left-side large-screen border pieces, including ornate corner posts and matching horizontal run fragments. Seen framing the full-screen party and dialogue references.

elements.label: Outer border right ornate set
elements.notes: Candidate right-side large-screen border pieces, including mirrored corner posts, long top-run segments, and right-hand join pieces.

elements.label: Menu corner and toggle marks
elements.notes: Small UI marks and corner fragments used inside menus: corner elbows, square markers, and compact frame fragments.

elements.label: Cursor and small icon set
elements.notes: Includes the right-pointing menu cursor, a boxed variant, and nearby small symbols used in menus and stats screens.

elements.label: Separator and border run set
elements.notes: Long vertical and horizontal runs used as section dividers and border continuations inside larger panels and HUD layouts.

elements.label: Panel corner variants
elements.notes: A row of compact panel-corner and edge variants that look suited to smaller label boxes and inset panels.

elements.label: Panel variants and filler tiles
elements.notes: Compact frame fragments and fill/pattern tiles that may support smaller boxes, panel backgrounds, or ornamental insets.

elements.label: Wordmark and symbol row
elements.notes: Includes the minimal_8 wordmark row, curled symbol, boxy glyphs, and ornamental marks. Likely branding/decorative rather than panel construction.
